_comment: Phase B observations for 10 score-distance samples + 3 name-conflict cases. Callee names translated from Ghidra current_name to Watcom matched_name using crt_matches_9.5a.json. Helper functions outside the FidDb match set keep their Ghidra current_name.
_addr_to_matched: Built from crt_matches_9.5a.json: e.g. 0x47304 -> _gmtime, 0x46d61 -> __getctime, 0x3dd10 -> __STOSB, 0x3da65 -> __fill_buffer, 0x3d990 -> __qread, 0x3db16 -> __flush, 0x3d919 -> __ioalloc, 0x3d8ec -> __chktty, 0x3d761 -> __fprtf, 0x46a03 -> __qwrite, 0x462e2 -> _set_errno, 0x46a80 -> unlink, 0x3dbe7 -> remove, 0x46e03 -> mktime, 0x36d16 -> malloc, etc.

00047328.key_instructions: PUSH 0x54604 (static struct tm*); PUSH time arg; CALL _gmtime; thin wrapper
00047328.notes: Watcom gmtime(t) is a 2-arg wrapper around _gmtime(t, &static_tm). Static buffer at 0x54604 in DGROUP is the dedicated gmtime tm struct.

00036dc1.key_instructions: PUSH 0x5285a (= __iob[1] = stdout, computed as 0x52840 + 1*0x1A from crt_globals_map); PUSH fmt arg; PUSH &va_list; CALL __fprtf (Ghidra current name 'vfprintf')
00036dc1.notes: **Stream constant 0x5285a is stdout, NOT stderr.** __iob starts at 0x52840 with stride 0x1A; (0x5285a - 0x52840) / 0x1A = 1 = stdout. The function pushes stdout + fmt + va_list and calls __fprtf, which is exactly Watcom's printf wrapper. The Ghidra current_name 'crt_fprintf_stderr' is incorrect — the namer mistook stdout for stderr. matched_name 'printf' is correct.
